tools.name: property-maintenance_request-classify
tools.description: Classify a stated type only from an explicit token, and flag a documented safety keyword for a person to review. An unrecognized word is left unrecognized. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/request-classify. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-maintenance_priority-assess
tools.description: Apply a fixed order: a safety keyword, then a stated emergency, urgent, or routine urgency. A missing urgency is not treated as routine, and the result is not a safety verdict. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/priority-assess. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does

tools.name: property-maintenance_work-order-generate
tools.description: Write a draft from the stated property, type, issue, and contractor name. The draft is not sent and no contractor is dispatched. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/work-order-generate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-maintenance_contractor-quote-compare
tools.description: Compare supplied quotes by price, stated completion days, scope, and exclusions. The lowest price is not a recommendation, and different currencies are not converted. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/contractor-quote-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does

tools.name: property-maintenance_response-sla-check
tools.description: Compare a supplied response time with the service level for that stated urgency. No deadline is assumed when the caller does not supply one. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/response-sla-check. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-maintenance_repair-history-analyze
tools.description: Count supplied requests for the same property and type. A repeat is reported at three or more. The count is not a finding that the property is unsafe. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/repair-history-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-maintenance_invoice-validate
tools.description: Compare an invoice amount and scope with one linked quote. A difference is not an overcharge finding, and a stated paid status does not mean a payment was sent. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/invoice-validate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: property-maintenance_report
tools.description: Combine supplied request classes, safety keywords, quote comparisons, service levels, repeat repairs, and invoice differences. The report does not call a property safe or dispatch a contractor. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/property-maintenance/report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "property-maintenance" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: property-maintenance_response-sla-check · Private data: property-maintenance_request-classify · Public sink: property-maintenance_request-classify, property-maintenance_priority-assess, property-maintenance_work-order-generate, property-maintenance_contractor-quote-compare, property-maintenance_response-sla-check, property-maintenance_repair-history-analyze, property-maintenance_invoice-validate, property-maintenance_report · Destructive: property-maintenance_request-classify, property-maintenance_priority-assess, property-maintenance_work-order-generate, property-maintenance_contractor-quote-compare, property-maintenance_response-sla-check, property-maintenance_repair-history-analyze, property-maintenance_invoice-validate, property-maintenance_report.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
